concept.title: In case of an emergency while driving

keywords.indexterm: in case of an emergency while driving

section.title: If the vehicle stalls while driving

li.p: Reduce the speed and keep a straight line.
Stop the vehicle to a safe place.
Turn the hazard warning flasher on.
If the vehicle still does not start, contact a professional workshop or seek other qualified assistance. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

section.title: If the vehicle stalls at a crossroad or crossing

li.p: Push the vehicle to a safe place.

section.title: If you have a flat tire while driving

li.p: Reduce the speed slowly and keep a straight line.
Stop the vehicle to a safe leveled place away from traffic.
Turn the hazard warning flasher on.
Have all passengers get out of the vehicle away from traffic.
